title: Pizza Love® board game: monkey cards 01–33
kuvaus: All 33 monkey cards of the Pizza Love® board game and what to do. Find your card by its number.
ingressi: If you made at least one pizza on your turn, draw a monkey card at the end of your turn. Find the card’s number and do what it says.
kaytto: Monkey cards are used in the basic game and in Secret Pizzas, not in Hungry Monkeys. To make the game easier, leave the monkey cards out.
yleista: Your turn ends when you draw the monkey card. If the card brings toppings to the line, they stay there for the next player: they first roll the dice and move toppings as usual, and only then make pizzas. A card that can be saved belongs to the player who drew it – only you decide when to play it.

kortit.nimi: Wow, what a thin and crispy pizza crust!
kortit.ohje: Roll the dice and play another turn.
Take one topping from the storage to the line and, if you want, remove one topping from the line.

kortit.nimi: There is something odd going on with the toppings.
kortit.ohje: Add one to the number on the dice.
kortit.huom: The card can be saved and played on anyone’s turn.
kortit.tarkennus: Play the card right after the dice is rolled, before any toppings are moved.

kortit.nimi: There is something odd going on with the toppings.
kortit.ohje: Subtract one from the number on the dice.
kortit.huom: The card can be saved and played on anyone’s turn.
kortit.tarkennus: Play the card right after the dice is rolled, before any toppings are moved. The number can become 0 if the dice shows 1. Then no toppings are moved.

kortit.ohje: Roll the dice twice – add toppings to the line both times. Pizzas are only made after both rolls.
kortit.huom: The card can be saved and played on anyone’s turn.
kortit.tarkennus: The player whose turn it is when the card is played rolls the dice again and moves toppings a second time.

kortit.ohje: Players get or lose slices: If you are in the lead, you lose one slice. If you are in the middle, you get one slice. If you are last, you get two slices.
kortit.huom: The card immediately affects all players. The players get to choose the slices.
kortit.tarkennus: Positions are decided by the number of slices in each box. Players in the same position get the same. If everyone has the same number of slices, everyone gets one slice.

kortit.ohje: Give one slice from your box to another player.
kortit.huom: The slice must be new for the other player.
kortit.tarkennus: Give a slice the other player does not have yet.

kortit.ohje: Rest for one round.
kortit.tarkennus: You skip your next roll.

kortit.ohje: Players’ boxes change owners clockwise.
Players’ boxes change owners counterclockwise.

kortit.nimi: Variety is the spice of life.
kortit.ohje: The direction of play changes.
kortit.huom: In a two-player game, you get a new turn right away.

kortit.ohje: Swap your box with any player.

kortit.nimi: Lunch break! The monkeys eat their slices.
kortit.ohje: All players lose slices according to the number shown on the card.
kortit.huom: If a player has only one slice, it is not removed.
kortit.tarkennus: The picture on the card shows how many slices each player loses: 2–3 slices in the box → lose 1, 4–5 → lose 2, 6–7 → lose 3, 8–9 → lose 4. Everyone chooses which slices to give back.

kortit.nimi: Someone forgot to maintain the suction system, and it got jammed.
kortit.ohje: All toppings on the line are moved to the storage.
All toppings are moved to the line.
kortit.huom: You can continue your turn by making pizzas. Draw a new monkey card at the end.
kortit.tarkennus: If you make at least one pizza, draw a new monkey card at the end.

kortit.ohje: The smallest toppings are moved to the storage. Starting with the smallest topping on the line, remove as many toppings as there are players in the game.
kortit.tarkennus: As many toppings (towers) are moved as there are players. In a three-player game, the three smallest toppings leave the line.

kortit.ohje: The largest toppings are moved to the storage. Starting with the largest topping on the line, remove as many toppings as there are players in the game.
kortit.tarkennus: As many toppings (towers) are moved as there are players. In a three-player game, the three largest toppings leave the line.

kortit.ohje: The value of the line increases by one. Move the toppings of your choice between the line and the storage.
kortit.tarkennus: Move toppings between the line and the storage so that the sum of the toppings on the line increases by one. Example: the line has pineapple (3) and tomato (2), so 5. Bring an olive (1) to the line, or swap the pineapple (3) for blue cheese (4).

kortit.ohje: The value of the line decreases by one. Move the toppings of your choice between the line and the storage.
kortit.tarkennus: Move toppings between the line and the storage so that the sum of the toppings on the line decreases by one. Example: the line has pineapple (3) and tomato (2), so 5. Swap the tomato (2) for an olive (1), or move both to the storage and bring blue cheese (4) instead.

kortit.nimi: You cough as you pump the bellows.
kortit.ohje: All odd toppings change place between the line and the storage.
kortit.tarkennus: The odd toppings are 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9. Those on the line go to the storage and those in the storage come to the line.

kortit.nimi: You sneeze as you push the bellows.
kortit.ohje: All even toppings change place between the line and the storage.
kortit.tarkennus: The even toppings are 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10. Those on the line go to the storage and those in the storage come to the line.

kortit.nimi: You laugh out loud and roll on top of the bellows.
kortit.ohje: All toppings that are divisible by three change place between the line and the storage.
kortit.tarkennus: The toppings divisible by three are 3, 6 and 9. Those on the line go to the storage and those in the storage come to the line.

kortit.nimi: You let out a toot, affecting the suction system’s pressure.
kortit.ohje: All toppings that are divisible by five change place between the line and the storage.
kortit.tarkennus: The toppings divisible by five are 5 and 10. Those on the line go to the storage and those in the storage come to the line.

kortit.nimi: You are particularly fond of small toppings.
kortit.ohje: Small toppings swap places between the line and the storage.
kortit.tarkennus: The small toppings are 1–5 (olive to shrimp). Those on the line go to the storage and those in the storage come to the line.

kortit.nimi: Oh, how you love large toppings.
kortit.ohje: Large toppings swap places between the line and the storage.
kortit.tarkennus: The large toppings are 6–10 (aubergine to fish). Those on the line go to the storage and those in the storage come to the line.

kortit.ohje: All toppings swap places between the line and the storage.
kortit.tarkennus: The toppings on the line go to the storage and the toppings in the storage come to the line. If the line was empty before the card was drawn, all toppings come to the line and it is a pizza party: the player who drew the card continues their turn.

kortit.ohje: You can cancel the effect of a monkey card.
kortit.huom: The card can be saved and played on anyone’s turn.
kortit.tarkennus: Play the card as soon as someone has drawn a monkey card. That card’s effect is cancelled.

kortit.nimi: The pizza boxes will thank you.
kortit.ohje: You get one free extra slice!
The toppings on the line are changed according to the icons on the card.
kortit.huom: Nothing happens to the toppings if both of them are on the line.
kortit.tarkennus: The card shows five topping pairs: olive ↔ ham, tomato ↔ mushroom, pineapple ↔ rocket, blue cheese ↔ aubergine and shrimp ↔ fish. If one of a pair is on the line and the other in the storage, they swap places.

kortit.nimi: You have pizza on your mind.
kortit.ohje: Make a pizza either before or after rolling the dice.
kortit.huom: The card can be saved and played later.
kortit.virhe: In the printed English rules, this card is numbered 31 by mistake.
kortit.tarkennus: Play the card on your own turn. You may make pizzas both before and after rolling the dice – that is, twice in the same turn.

kortit.ohje: Players can choose a slice from the previous player.
kortit.huom: The player whose turn it was starts. The slice must be new. If there is no new slice, the player gets nothing. However, that player must still give one of their own slices to the next player.
kortit.tarkennus: Everyone takes a slice they do not have yet from the player before them. The player whose turn it was chooses first, then the others in turn order. The slices go into the boxes only after everyone has chosen – so you can get back the slice you just gave away.

kortit.nimi: You are a legend among the pizza boxes!
kortit.ohje: Get two extra slices!
You lose all your slices.
